bibliographic.title: Mapillary based plant distributions of ethnobotanical distributions.: Pre-Talk
bibliographic.author: Dr Bheemaiah, Anil Kumar
bibliographic.description:
A pre-talk is a interactive fiction based slide presentation, coupled with a question and answer bot to answer all questions about the pre-talk. Analogous to a pre-print, a pre-talk is a supplement to a pre-print.
In this pre-talk, the author presents enhancements to the Mapillary panoptic segmentation software and the integration of Redtail, based trail navigation and automated imaging. This information is used in environmental conservation work, in plant distribution regression studies and in planning Miyawakis.
